observations: Large stack of blue plastic drums.
Tight-head design with two bung holes on the top surface.
Drums show external signs of use, including dirt, scuffs, and some markings.
Watermark 'EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on the images.
The drums appear to be the standard 200-220 liter (55 gallon) size.

claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Suitability depends entirely on the previous contents (contamination risk) and the chemical compatibility of the plastic with the intended liquid.

risks.risk: Contamination from previous contents (e.g., toxic chemicals or oil)
risks.proof: Photo of the original manufacturer's label or a clear shot of the interior.
risks.if_unproven: as non-food grade/industrial waste use only

risks.risk: Structural leaks or cracks in the base or sides
risks.proof: Video of a drum being pressure tested or filled with water.

risks.risk: Missing or stripped threads on bung caps
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the bung openings and caps.

proof_requests: Photo of the labels showing what was previously stored in the drums.
Close-up photo of the top of a single drum to check the condition of the bungs and seals.
Confirmation of the exact capacity in liters.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as standard industrial plastic drums. They can be priced at the worst-case value for used, non-food-grade containers.
